name: Stable Ectoplasm
summary: Near the ghosts of the Eastern Plaguelands, an Ectoplasmic Distiller can gather Stable Ectoplasm. Mux Manascrambler needs it to reach spirits whose souls have not left this world.

sections.title: Among the Ghosts
sections.body: Mux Manascrambler asks for Stable Ectoplasm from the ghosts and banshees of the Eastern Plaguelands. He needs it alongside two other kinds of ectoplasm, gathered from Silithus and Winterspring. The distiller draws out the substance from nearby incorporeal undead. Northdale is a good place to find them.

faq.answer: Stable Ectoplasm is a substance gathered from ghosts and banshees in the Eastern Plaguelands with an Ectoplasmic Distiller.
Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan needs Stable Ectoplasm, along with Scorched and Frozen Ectoplasm, for his work with the Ectoplasmic Distiller.

faq.q: Where can I find Stable Ectoplasm?
faq.answer: Ghosts and banshees in the Eastern Plaguelands yield Stable Ectoplasm. Northdale is a good place to find them.
Mux hopes to use the otherworldly energy in the ectoplasm to reach spirits whose souls have not quite left this world.

angles.text: Mux calls the Ectoplasmic Distiller a fine piece of engineering. His work shows how goblin contraptions can be put to use in studying the spirit world.
